Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.scoreboard

Class SidebarRender

java.lang.Object
dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.scoreboard.SidebarRender
public final class SidebarRender extends Object
One sidebar about to be shown to one player, which a SidebarContributor may change.

Title and lines are rendered text in Zentrix's colour format (& codes and &#RRGGBB hex colours), with Zentrix's own placeholders and PlaceholderAPI already resolved. A sidebar shows at most 15 lines; extra lines are dropped. Text a contributor adds is shown as written, so it must respect identity masking itself - use the player's display name rather than their real one.

Since:
1.8.0
